records.title: Keep the legislation pack stable and add a federation root
records.context: Existing public descriptor is a strong, bounded legislation work catalogue.
records.decision: Preserve it as one source-family pack and publish a Whole-Law root that references it.
rejected: Copy legislation records into every new pack

records.title: Hybrid federation rather than universal harvest
records.context: Sources differ in licence, scale, volatility, structure and public access.
records.decision: Ship governed metadata/indexes locally; hydrate authoritative text live or from licensed snapshots.
consequences: Source availability remains a runtime dependency
rejected: Live-only metasearch with no audit snapshot

records.title: Composable ontology stack
records.context: No single ontology adequately models legislation, case law, procedure, regulation and provenance.
records.decision: Use ELI/AKN/LRM/PROV/DCAT/SKOS/OWL-Time/Web Annotation/ODRL/SHACL with minimal okflaw terms.

records.title: Source-native identifiers are immutable evidence
records.decision: Retain native IDs and map through reviewed identity decisions; similarity never creates owl:sameAs.

records.title: Separate citation occurrence from legal treatment
records.context: A citation does not prove following, approval or negative treatment.
records.decision: Store occurrences automatically; publish treatment edges only with passage evidence, confidence and review state.

records.title: Temporal context is mandatory, not optional metadata
records.decision: Every consequential proposition carries version, point-in-time, jurisdiction, extent and retrieval context.

records.title: Coverage claims require denominators
records.context: Record counts invite unjustified “all law” claims.
records.decision: Only denominator-supported coverage percentages are displayed; other states are qualitative and gap-visible.

records.title: Licence/purpose controls are executable policy inputs
records.context: FCL and CaTH computational analysis is licensed/restricted.
records.decision: Source adapters and query plans check policy/purpose before access; restricted sources can remain metadata-only.
rejected: Assume public web equals bulk-reuse permission

records.title: Passage-first provenance
records.context: Homepage/document citations are inadequate for legal propositions.
records.decision: Material propositions point to the smallest authoritative passage with selector, extract, hash and retrieval event.

records.title: No automated professional legal judgment
records.context: Source retrieval does not resolve fact disputes, discretion or professional duties.
records.decision: Mandatory escalation for missing facts, conflicts, high consequences, non-public material and uncertain controlling authority.

records.title: Browser-first control plane; server when unavoidable
records.context: Explorer is static/GitHub Pages but whole-law search can exceed browser constraints.
records.decision: Keep descriptors, ledgers, static indexes and route hydration browser-capable; use server services for large/licensed/semantic/temporal workloads.

records.title: Deterministic immutable snapshots
records.context: Legal answers must be reproducible after source change.
records.decision: Bind every local shard and index to snapshot IDs and SHA-256 roots, reusing Explorer release data-plane controls.
rejected: Mutable latest JSON files without hashes

records.title: Delete/correction events remain first-class
records.context: Sources withdraw, correct and redact records.
records.decision: Tombstone/supersede local indexes; retain audit metadata where lawful and never serve withdrawn text as current.

records.title: Existing 100-question benchmark remains a regression stratum
records.context: It is statute/barrister focused but valuable.
records.decision: Do not overwrite it; add 360 whole-law questions and report both scores.

records.title: Independent red-team gate before source-family promotion
records.context: A plausible corpus can still be dangerously incomplete.
records.decision: Every phase requires a separately run adversarial checklist and expert sampling before “stable”.
